    21→	// ProposerIndicesCacheHit tracks the number of proposerIndices requests that are in the cache.
    22→	ProposerIndicesCacheHit = promauto.NewCounter(prometheus.CounterOpts{
    23→		Name: "proposer_indices_cache_hit",
    24→		Help: "The number of proposer indices requests that are present in the cache.",
    25→	})
    26→)
    27→
    28→// ProposerIndicesCache keeps track of the proposer indices in the next two
    29→// epochs. It is keyed by the state root of the last epoch before. That is, for
    30→// blocks during epoch 2, for example slot 65, it will be keyed by the state
    31→// root of slot 63 (last slot in epoch 1).
    32→// The cache keeps two sets of indices computed, the "safe" set is computed
    33→// right before the epoch transition into the current epoch. For example for
    34→// epoch 2 we will compute this list after importing block 63. The "unsafe"
    35→// version is computed an epoch in advance, for example for epoch 3, it will be
    36→// computed after importing block 63.
    37→//
    38→// The cache also keeps a map from checkpoints to state roots so that one is
    39→// able to access the proposer indices list from a checkpoint instead. The
    40→// checkpoint is the checkpoint for the epoch previous to the requested
    41→// proposer indices. That is, for a slot in epoch 2 (eg. 65), the checkpoint
    42→// root would be for slot 32 if present.
    43→type ProposerIndicesCache struct {
    44→	sync.Mutex
    45→	indices map[primitives.Epoch]map[[32]byte][fieldparams.SlotsPerEpoch]primitives.ValidatorIndex
    46→	rootMap map[forkchoicetypes.Checkpoint][32]byte // A map from checkpoint root to state root
    47→}
    48→
    49→// NewProposerIndicesCache returns a newly created cache
    50→func NewProposerIndicesCache() *ProposerIndicesCache {
    51→	return &ProposerIndicesCache{
    52→		indices: make(map[primitives.Epoch]map[[32]byte][fieldparams.SlotsPerEpoch]primitives.ValidatorIndex),
    53→		rootMap: make(map[forkchoicetypes.Checkpoint][32]byte),
    54→	}
    55→}
    56→
    57→// ProposerIndices returns the proposer indices (safe) for the given root
    58→func (p *ProposerIndicesCache) ProposerIndices(epoch primitives.Epoch, root [32]byte) ([fieldparams.SlotsPerEpoch]primitives.ValidatorIndex, bool) {
    59→	p.Lock()
    60→	defer p.Unlock()
    61→	inner, ok := p.indices[epoch]
    62→	if !ok {
    63→		ProposerIndicesCacheMiss.Inc()
    64→		return [fieldparams.SlotsPerEpoch]primitives.ValidatorIndex{}, false
    65→	}
    66→	indices, exists := inner[root]
    67→	if exists {
    68→		ProposerIndicesCacheHit.Inc()
    69→	} else {
    70→		ProposerIndicesCacheMiss.Inc()
    71→	}
    72→	return indices, exists
    73→}
    74→
    75→// Prune resets the ProposerIndicesCache to its initial state
    76→func (p *ProposerIndicesCache) Prune(epoch primitives.Epoch) {
    77→	p.Lock()
    78→	defer p.Unlock()
    79→	for key := range p.indices {
    80→		if key < epoch {
    81→			delete(p.indices, key)
    82→		}
    83→	}
    84→	for key := range p.rootMap {
    85→		if key.Epoch+1 < epoch {
    86→			delete(p.rootMap, key)
    87→		}
    88→	}
    89→}
    90→
    91→// Set sets the proposer indices for the given root as key
    92→func (p *ProposerIndicesCache) Set(epoch primitives.Epoch, root [32]byte, indices [fieldparams.SlotsPerEpoch]primitives.ValidatorIndex) {
    93→	p.Lock()
    94→	defer p.Unlock()
    95→
    96→	inner, ok := p.indices[epoch]
    97→	if !ok {
    98→		inner = make(map[[32]byte][fieldparams.SlotsPerEpoch]primitives.ValidatorIndex)
    99→		p.indices[epoch] = inner
   100→	}
   101→	inner[root] = indices
   102→}
   103→
   104→// SetCheckpoint updates the map from checkpoints to state roots
   105→func (p *ProposerIndicesCache) SetCheckpoint(c forkchoicetypes.Checkpoint, root [32]byte) {
   106→	p.Lock()
   107→	defer p.Unlock()
   108→	p.rootMap[c] = root
   109→}
   110→
   111→// IndicesFromCheckpoint returns the proposer indices from a checkpoint rather than the state root
   112→func (p *ProposerIndicesCache) IndicesFromCheckpoint(c forkchoicetypes.Checkpoint) ([fieldparams.SlotsPerEpoch]primitives.ValidatorIndex, bool) {
   113→	p.Lock()
   114→	emptyIndices := [fieldparams.SlotsPerEpoch]primitives.ValidatorIndex{}
   115→	root, ok := p.rootMap[c]
   116→	p.Unlock()
   117→	if !ok {
   118→		ProposerIndicesCacheMiss.Inc()
   119→		return emptyIndices, ok
   120→	}
   121→	return p.ProposerIndices(c.Epoch+1, root)
   122→}
